hero.title: Explore the world on your own terms
hero.description: LiteLifeTrip simplifies your adventure. From hidden local gems to seamless route planning, unlock the full potential of your next journey.

chooseReasons.title: Why Choose LiteLifeTrip
chooseReasons.description: We understand that you don't have time for long planning, and weekends can be the only chance to recharge. LiteLifeTrip is designed to turn trip preparation from a stress into a pleasure.

items.title: Save your most valuable resource — time
items.description: Instead of dozens of browser tabs and hours of research — one app that gathers everything. We do the routine work so you can relax this Friday.

items.title: True psychological relief
items.description: We lift the 'burden of choice' from your shoulders. LiteLifeTrip automatically picks a route, and makes a preview packing list depending on the weather.

items.title: Adaptive Itineraries
items.description: Change of plans? No problem. Drag, drop, and reshuffle your day instantly, with smart suggestions filling in the gaps.

offers.title: What We Offer
offers.description: Discover the comprehensive suite of features designed to make every step of your journey seamless and enjoyable.
offers.quote: The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.

items.title: Create packing lists

testimonials.title: Loved by Travelers
testimonials.description: See what our community has to say.

items.name: Elena Rodriguez
items.text: The best app for planning my solo trips. The packing lists are a lifesaver, and I love seeing my travel stats grow!

items.name: Alex Chen
items.text: I used to spend hours planning. LiteLifeTrip did it in minutes, and the recommendations were spot on.

items.name: Marta Kowalski
items.text: Perfect for weekend getaways and short trips. Clean UI and very intuitive to use.

items.name: Sarah Jenkins
items.text: A must-have for any frequent traveler. It keeps everything organized and makes the whole travel experience stress-free.

items.name: Lucas Meyer
items.text: I travel constantly for work, and this app helps me stay on top of routes, packing, and schedules.

items.name: Aisha Rahman
items.text: The statistics and trip history features are incredible. It feels built exactly for my lifestyle.

items.name: Daniel Thompson
items.text: Hands down the most powerful travel planner I've used. It handles complex multi-country trips effortlessly.

items.name: Isabella Moretti
items.text: I love how everything syncs together — routes, notes, stats. It feels premium and very polished.

items.name: Kenji Tanaka
items.text: An essential tool for long-term travelers. The insights and planning tools save so much time.
